blocks.text: Zyada temperature ya munasib halaat mein alkanes do qisam ki reactions karte hain.

items: Thermal aur catalytic reactions (garmi ya catalyst se hone wali reactions), maslan combustion (jalna) aur cracking (bari molecules ka chhoti molecules mein tootna).
Free radical substitution reactions: woh reactions jin mein free radical mechanism ke zariye aik atom ya atoms ka group kisi doosre atom ya group se badal (replace ho) jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Alkanes kaun si bari qisam ki reactions karte hain (Quick Check 11.3b)?
blocks.explanation: Thermal aur catalytic reactions, jaise oxygen mein jalna (combustion) aur lambi chains ka chhoti chains mein tootna (cracking); aur free radical substitution, jis mein UV roshni mein halogen atom hydrogen atom ki jagah le leta hai.

items: Alkanes do qisam ki reactions karte hain: thermal aur catalytic (combustion, cracking) aur free radical substitution.
